This Job Description outlines skill & experience requirements necessary to fulfill a Data Developer role with the Anseta Data Team. We are seeking out a self-driven individual to handle analytical, software development, and process development surrounding the ingestion, analysis, and reporting of financial data covering decentralized assets to traditional financial instruments to internal cost reporting.

Role & Responsibilities Summary

This role of Data Developer is a hybrid role between data analyst and developer. An understanding of how data analytics and product development intersect will be essential for fulfilling the duties of the role. Our team is international and primarily communicates in English. The Anseta team is a highly diverse team which means this role requires a level of flexibility in both work hours and communication styles.
